keyPoints.en: Vectors have magnitude and direction (displacement, velocity, force); scalars have magnitude only (distance, speed, mass).
keyPoints.bm: Vektor mempunyai magnitud dan arah (sesaran, halaju, daya); skalar hanya magnitud (jarak, laju, jisim).

keyPoints.en: Notation: AB with an arrow, bold a, or a with ~ underneath. |AB| is its magnitude.
keyPoints.bm: Tatatanda: AB dengan anak panah, a tebal, atau a dengan ~ di bawah. |AB| ialah magnitudnya.

keyPoints.en: Equal vectors: same magnitude and direction. Negative vector −a: same magnitude, opposite direction.
keyPoints.bm: Vektor sama: magnitud dan arah sama. Vektor negatif −a: magnitud sama, arah bertentangan.

keyPoints.en: Multiplying by a scalar k changes the magnitude by |k|; if k < 0 the direction reverses.
keyPoints.bm: Mendarab dengan skalar k mengubah magnitud sebanyak |k|; jika k < 0 arah bertukar.

keyPoints.en: Parallel vectors: a = kb. Points A, B, C are collinear if AB = k·BC.
keyPoints.bm: Vektor selari: a = kb. Titik A, B, C segaris jika AB = k·BC.

question.en: AB = 2a + 4b and BC = a + 2b. Show A, B, C are collinear.
question.bm: AB = 2a + 4b dan BC = a + 2b. Tunjukkan A, B, C segaris.

answer.en: AB = 2(a + 2b) = 2BC, so AB ∥ BC and they share B → collinear.
answer.bm: AB = 2(a + 2b) = 2BC, jadi AB ∥ BC dan berkongsi B → segaris.

tip.en: For collinear proofs, state BOTH: parallel AND a common point.
tip.bm: Untuk bukti segaris, nyatakan KEDUA-DUA: selari DAN titik sepunya.

keyPoints.bm: Hukum segi tiga: AB + BC = AC (hujung ke pangkal).

keyPoints.en: Parallelogram law: if a and b start at the same point, a + b is the diagonal.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum segi empat selari: jika a dan b bermula dari titik yang sama, a + b ialah pepenjuru.

keyPoints.en: Polygon law: AB + BC + CD = AD.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum poligon: AB + BC + CD = AD.

keyPoints.en: Subtraction: a − b = a + (−b). Useful: AB = OB − OA.
keyPoints.bm: Penolakan: a − b = a + (−b). Berguna: AB = OB − OA.

keyPoints.en: If a, b are non-parallel and ha + kb = ma + nb, then h = m and k = n.
keyPoints.bm: Jika a, b tidak selari dan ha + kb = ma + nb, maka h = m dan k = n.

question.en: In parallelogram OABC, OA = a, OC = c. Express OB and AC.
question.bm: Dalam segi empat selari OABC, OA = a, OC = c. Ungkapkan OB dan AC.

answer.en: OB = a + c; AC = OC − OA = c − a
answer.bm: OB = a + c; AC = OC − OA = c − a

tip.en: Draw the diagram and trace a path along known vectors.
tip.bm: Lukis rajah dan surih laluan melalui vektor yang diketahui.

keyPoints.en: i and j are unit vectors along the x- and y-axes. Any vector r = xi + yj (or column vector).
keyPoints.bm: i dan j ialah vektor unit sepanjang paksi-x dan paksi-y. Sebarang vektor r = xi + yj (atau vektor lajur).

keyPoints.en: Magnitude |r| = √(x² + y²). Unit vector r̂ = r/|r|.
keyPoints.bm: Magnitud |r| = √(x² + y²). Vektor unit r̂ = r/|r|.

keyPoints.en: Add/subtract by components: (a₁i + a₂j) ± (b₁i + b₂j) = (a₁ ± b₁)i + (a₂ ± b₂)j.
keyPoints.bm: Tambah/tolak mengikut komponen: (a₁i + a₂j) ± (b₁i + b₂j) = (a₁ ± b₁)i + (a₂ ± b₂)j.

keyPoints.en: Position vector of A(x, y) is OA = xi + yj.
keyPoints.bm: Vektor kedudukan A(x, y) ialah OA = xi + yj.

keyPoints.en: Applications: resultant velocity of a boat in a current, plane in the wind.
keyPoints.bm: Aplikasi: halaju paduan bot dalam arus, pesawat dalam angin.

question.en: A boat moves at 4j km/h in a current of 3i km/h. Find its resultant speed.
question.bm: Sebuah bot bergerak pada 4j km/j dalam arus 3i km/j. Cari laju paduannya.

tip.en: Magnitude is always positive; components can be negative.
tip.bm: Magnitud sentiasa positif; komponen boleh negatif.
